target_source: KOSIS DT_1ES3B05S KSIC10 2024H1, one decimal thousand persons
rules: All required broad-section components must be numeric; non-numeric hyphens are missing, not zero.
Target and origin employment must be positive; all compared models must use identical keys.
2023 OECD origin values correspond to KOSIS 2023H1; 2024 target H1 gives a one-year horizon.
The existing OECD 2022 values correspond to KOSIS 2022H2; existing 2022->2023 targets are six-month changes; do not describe entire original panel as homogeneous annual changes.
Do not refit or select parameters using new outcomes.
2025 and KSIC11 series are excluded pending separate same-vintage/classification/period checks.
acquisition: Official rendered-table DOM, not downloaded CSV/XLS
